007package com.oracle.database.selectai.model.agent;
008
009import com.fasterxml.jackson.annotation.JsonInclude;
010import com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.ObjectMapper;
011import com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.PropertyNamingStrategies;
012
013import java.util.ArrayList;
014import java.util.Collections;
015import java.util.List;
016
017/**
018 * Attributes used to create a Select AI Agent team.
019 *
020 * <p>The JSON representation follows the {@code CREATE_TEAM} attributes
021 * accepted by {@code DBMS_CLOUD_AI_AGENT}. The database requires the
022 * {@code agents} attribute and uses a default long-term memory length of 30
023 * when {@code longTermMemoryLength} is not specified. Required-field and
024 * other database-specific validation is delegated to Oracle Database; the
025 * SDK performs only the documented Java range validation.</p>
026 *
027 * <p>For a supervisor-led team, {@code supervisorAgent} references an agent
028 * created with {@link AgentAttributes.Builder#supervisor(Boolean) supervisor(true)}.
029 * The {@code agents} mappings contain workers only, not the selected supervisor.
030 * Use {@code process("sequential")} for one-at-a-time worker delegation.</p>
031 *
032 * @see <a href="{@docRoot}/src-html/com/oracle/database/selectai/samples/agent/CreateTeamSample.html">
033 *      CreateTeamSample source</a>
034 * @see <a href="{@docRoot}/src-html/com/oracle/database/selectai/samples/agent/SetTeamAttributesSample.html">
035 *      SetTeamAttributesSample source</a>
036 * @since 1.1.0
037 */
038public final class TeamAttributes {
039    /** Configured once and never mutated; shared across attribute serializations. */
040    private static final ObjectMapper MAPPER = new ObjectMapper()
041            .setPropertyNamingStrategy(PropertyNamingStrategies.SNAKE_CASE)
042            .setDefaultPropertyInclusion(JsonInclude.Include.NON_NULL);
043
044    /** Agent and task mappings included in the team. */
045    private final List<TeamMember> agents;
046    /** Team task execution process, such as {@code sequential}. */
047    private final String process;
048    /** Maximum number of prior task summaries retained as team memory. */
049    private final Integer longTermMemoryLength;
050    /** Name of an existing agent created with the supervisor flag enabled. */
051    private final String supervisorAgent;
052
053    private TeamAttributes(Builder builder) {
054        this.agents = builder.agents == null
055                ? null
056                : Collections.unmodifiableList(new ArrayList<>(builder.agents));
057        this.process = builder.process;
058        this.longTermMemoryLength = builder.longTermMemoryLength;
059        this.supervisorAgent = builder.supervisorAgent;
060    }
061
062    /**
063     * Returns the team agent and task mappings, or {@code null} when unset.
064     *
065     * @return team agent and task mappings, or {@code null}
066     */
067    public List<TeamMember> getAgents() {
068        return agents;
069    }
070
071    /**
072     * Returns the team task execution process.
073     *
074     * @return team task execution process, or {@code null} when unset
075     */
076    public String getProcess() {
077        return process;
078    }
079
080    /**
081     * Returns the configured long-term memory length, or {@code null} when the
082     * database default applies.
083     *
084     * @return long-term memory length, or {@code null} when unset
085     */
086    public Integer getLongTermMemoryLength() {
087        return longTermMemoryLength;
088    }
089
090    /**
091     * Returns the supervisor agent name, or {@code null} for a regular team.
092     *
093     * @return supervisor agent name, or {@code null}
094     */
095    public String getSupervisorAgent() {
096        return supervisorAgent;
097    }
098
099    /**
100     * Creates a builder for team attributes.
101     *
102     * @return mutable builder for team attributes
103     */
104    public static Builder builder() {
105        return new Builder();
106    }
107
108    /**
109     * Serializes attributes using the snake-case names expected by
110     * {@code DBMS_CLOUD_AI_AGENT}.
111     *
112     * @return JSON object containing non-null attributes
113     * @throws IllegalStateException when the attributes cannot be serialized
114     */
115    public String toJson() {
116        try {
117            return MAPPER.writeValueAsString(this);
118        } catch (Exception e) {
119            throw new IllegalStateException("Failed to serialize TeamAttributes", e);
120        }
121    }
122
123    /** Builder for {@link TeamAttributes}. */
124    public static final class Builder {
125        /** Agent and task mappings included in the team. */
126        private List<TeamMember> agents;
127        /** Team task execution process. */
128        private String process;
129        /** Maximum number of prior task summaries retained as team memory. */
130        private Integer longTermMemoryLength;
131        /** Name of an existing agent created with the supervisor flag enabled. */
132        private String supervisorAgent;
133
134        /**
135         * Sets the team agent and task mappings.
136         *
137         * @param agents team members; the list is copied by the builder
138         * @return this builder
139         */
140        public Builder agents(List<TeamMember> agents) {
141            this.agents = agents == null ? null : new ArrayList<>(agents);
142            return this;
143        }
144
145        /**
146         * Sets the team task execution process, such as {@code sequential}.
147         *
148         * @param process database-defined team process
149         * @return this builder
150         */
151        public Builder process(String process) {
152            this.process = process;
153            return this;
154        }
155
156        /**
157         * Sets the maximum number of prior task summaries retained as team
158         * memory. A {@code null} value uses the database default of 30.
159         *
160         * @param longTermMemoryLength memory length; must not be negative
161         * @return this builder
162         * @throws IllegalArgumentException when the value is negative
163         */
164        public Builder longTermMemoryLength(Integer longTermMemoryLength) {
165            if (longTermMemoryLength != null && longTermMemoryLength < 0) {
166                throw new IllegalArgumentException("longTermMemoryLength must be non-negative");
167            }
168            this.longTermMemoryLength = longTermMemoryLength;
169            return this;
170        }
171
172        /**
173         * Assigns an existing supervisor agent to this team. Create that agent
174         * with {@link AgentAttributes.Builder#supervisor(Boolean) supervisor(true)}
175         * first, and keep it out of {@link #agents(List)}. Use
176         * {@code process("sequential")} for worker delegation.
177         *
178         * <p>For a runnable example, see
179         * <a href="{@docRoot}/src-html/com/oracle/database/selectai/samples/agent/SupervisorTeamSample.html">
180         * SupervisorTeamSample source</a>.</p>
181         *
182         * @param supervisorAgent supervisor agent name
183         * @return this builder
184         */
185        public Builder supervisorAgent(String supervisorAgent) {
186            this.supervisorAgent = supervisorAgent;
187            return this;
188        }
189
190        /**
191         * Builds team attributes without validating required database fields.
192         * Required-field and semantic validation is performed by
193         * {@code DBMS_CLOUD_AI_AGENT} when the team is created.
194         *
195         * @return immutable team attributes
196         */
197        public TeamAttributes build() {
198            return new TeamAttributes(this);
199        }
200    }
201
202    /** Team member definition used in agent-team attributes. */
203    public static final class TeamMember {
204        /** Agent name. */
205        private final String name;
206        /** Task routed to the agent. */
207        private final String task;
208
209        private TeamMember(MemberBuilder builder) {
210            this.name = builder.name;
211            this.task = builder.task;
212        }
213
214        /**
215         * Creates a builder for a team member definition.
216         *
217         * @param name agent name, validated by the database when the team is created
218         * @return team member builder
219         */
220        public static MemberBuilder builder(String name) {
221            return new MemberBuilder(name);
222        }
223
224        /**
225         * Returns the agent name.
226         *
227         * @return agent name
228         */
229        public String getName() {
230            return name;
231        }
232
233        /**
234         * Returns the task routed to the agent.
235         *
236         * @return task name
237         */
238        public String getTask() {
239            return task;
240        }
241
242        /** Builder for {@link TeamMember}. */
243        public static final class MemberBuilder {
244            /** Agent or task name. */
245            private final String name;
246            /** Task routed to the agent. */
247            private String task;
248
249            private MemberBuilder(String name) {
250                this.name = name;
251            }
252
253            /**
254             * Sets the task routed to the agent.
255             *
256             * @param task task name, validated by the database when the team is created
257             * @return this member builder
258             */
259            public MemberBuilder task(String task) {
260                this.task = task;
261                return this;
262            }
263
264            /**
265             * Builds a team member definition without validating required
266             * database fields. Required-field validation is performed by
267             * {@code DBMS_CLOUD_AI_AGENT} when the team is created.
268             *
269             * @return immutable team member definition
270             */
271            public TeamMember build() {
272                return new TeamMember(this);
273            }
274        }
275    }
276}
